title: SUNTRACS and allied groups protest CSS bill at the National Assembly
location: Grounds of the National Assembly, Panama City
scope: Capital-city gathering over national pension policy
organizer: SUNTRACS, CONUSI-linked groups, university students/PAT, and Asoprof teachers are reported among participants; umbrella organizer unclear
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance count or estimate in the reviewed La Prensa body. The La Estrella rendered result also had no count; its raw response was not archived. >=50 remains unestablished.

occurrence.evidence: La Prensa body reports social groups protesting at the National Assembly over the CSS bill; La Estrella body was visibly rendered but its raw result was not preserved.

date.evidence: Both articles are dated 6 Nov 2024 and describe the demonstration at the Assembly that day.

location.evidence: Both reports locate groups at the National Assembly; La Estrella says they were on the grounds awaiting presentation of the bill.

state_target.evidence: Participants opposed the government-proposed CSS reform bill before the legislature and defended the social security system.

threshold_50.evidence: Reviewed body gives no count; threshold pending.

continuity.evidence: Article documents the action on 6 Nov only; no continuation established.

notes: Keep separate from the student road actions on 6-7 Nov: different site and action. La Estrella and La Prensa describe the same Assembly gathering and are not two events. La Estrella body capture gap is explicit.
open_questions: How many people attended simultaneously at the Assembly on 6 Nov?
Did authorities respond directly to the protest beyond the bill presentation?
Can any independent source support a turnout estimate?

title: University student protest on the Transístmica, first reported day
location: Vía Transístmica near the University of Panama, Panama City; exact gathering point not independently established
scope: Street protest over the CSS bill; one reported day of a two-day run
organizer: University students; organization not clearly identified in the reviewed La Prensa body
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance count or estimate reported; >=50 remains unestablished.

occurrence.evidence: The 7 Nov La Prensa report says students were protesting for a second consecutive day, supporting a prior action on 6 Nov.

date.evidence: The report dated 7 Nov identifies the protest as the second consecutive day; the prior day is 6 Nov.

location.evidence: The report locates the consecutive-day protests on/near the Vía Transístmica; exact site for 6 Nov not separately given.

state_target.evidence: Students protested the CSS reform bill debated by the national government and legislature.

threshold_50.evidence: No attendance estimate in reviewed text.

continuity.evidence: The article describes a second consecutive protest day, but each date is retained as a distinct action; no later continuation is known.

notes: Separate from the Assembly gathering on the same date. Date-specific occurrence rests on the next-day article's statement that the 7 Nov action was day two; no direct Nov 6 count/source preserved.
open_questions: Was there a distinct public gathering of students on 6 Nov and what was its exact site?
How many people attended simultaneously on 6 Nov?
Were there participant arrests or other state actions on this first day?

title: University student protest on the Transístmica, second reported day
location: Vía Transístmica near the University of Panama, Panama City
scope: Street protest over the CSS bill; second reported day of a two-day run
organizer: University students; organization not clearly identified in the reviewed La Prensa body
threshold_50_evidence: No attendance count or estimate reported; >=50 remains unestablished.

occurrence.evidence: La Prensa reports students protested on 7 Nov on the Transístmica; police intervened and traffic was disrupted.

date.evidence: Article is dated 7 Nov 2024 and reports the action that day.

location.evidence: Article locates the action on/near the Vía Transístmica by the University of Panama.

state_target.evidence: Students opposed the CSS bill; this is a demand concerning national government and legislative policy.

continuity.evidence: Reported as second consecutive day after 6 Nov; no later continuation established.

notes: Keep separate from 6 Nov first-day student action and the Assembly protest; no merge by issue alone.
open_questions: How many students or other participants attended simultaneously on 7 Nov?
Were police dispersal tactics, arrests or injuries reported in a separate contemporaneous source?
Did the action continue after 7 Nov?
